headline: Kim A-Lim Ties For Seventh At LPGA CME Group Tour Championship
seoTitle: Kim A-Lim Ties For Seventh At LPGA Tour Championship
metaDescription: South Korean golfer Kim A-Lim concludes the 2026 LPGA season with a seventh-place finish at the CME Group Tour Championship held in Naples, Florida.
aiSummaryBullets: Kim A-Lim finished in a tie for seventh place at the CME Group Tour Championship in Naples, Florida.
The golfer concluded the 2026 LPGA Tour season with an 18-under 270 score over the four-day event.
This result marks Kim A-Lim's 10th top-10 performance during the 2026 competitive season.
aiContextParagraph: The CME Group Tour Championship, held at the Tiburon Golf Club in Naples, Florida, serves as the final event of the 2026 LPGA Tour season. Kim A-Lim entered the final round as the 54-hole leader but ultimately finished tied for seventh place after recording an 18-under 270 on the par-72 course. The tournament concluded with Jeeno Thitikul securing the victory, marking her third consecutive win at this specific event. Throughout the 2026 season, Kim A-Lim demonstrated consistent form, achieving a total of 10 top-10 finishes. The event, which carries a significant winner's purse, brought an end to the professional tour schedule for the year. Coverage of the tournament highlighted both the final standings and the trajectory of the season for participating professional golfers, including Thitikul's late-season surge and Kim's overall performance metrics.
whyItIsViral: The event generated moderate interest across two independent news outlets as golf fans tracked the final standings of the 2026 LPGA season.
